about_the_game:
Fill your party with armored knights and samurai thanks to the Fantasy Character Pack 3! Gee-kun-soft is back with 16 new characters who can flesh out your party, fill your towns with helpful NPCs, and serve as deadly antagonists. Each character comes with an MZ-style walking character sprite, SV batter, front-view enemy images (with 13 recolors and versions with magical effects), faceset with 8 emotions, and busts with 8 emotions so that you can easily add them wherever you want.

5 knights and 7 samurai offer your players options for their party composition, or use them as NPCs who can teach your heroes new skills. Let your players choose the blonde knight armed with a lance and shield or the upbeat samurai with a powerful bow to help defeat a dragon, and learn new defensive skills from a heavily armored swordswoman or a wise white-haired samurai tactician. Want some less common party members? A dragon knight, harpy, a male priest, and even satan can add unique combat styles for your battles, or cause trouble when they launch a surprise attack on your party!

This pack also includes high-resolution full body images of each character, so that you can resize them to perfectly fit your game’s resolution for cutscenes or add art of them to your game’s codex. Pick up Fantasy Character Pack 3 and add an upbeat priest, a stoic tactician, a sword-swinging knight, and more to your game!


Contents:

・16 battlers with 13 variations each (also, some have effect version)
・16 walking sprites
・16 animated SV battlers
・16 facesets with 8 emotions each
・16 portrait bust images with 8 emotions each (also, some have effect version)
・BONUS: All 16 characters in large-scale full-character artwork



Terms of Use:

This pack is for use in RPG Maker Series or the engine of your choice.
OK to be used in Commercial projects
Contents can be edited
OK for use in games with gore
OK for use in adult-rated games
